note: Take Away Again and Again: twelve candies, four taken away three times, which is the same as twelve divided by four. Quiz: hear a repeated subtraction and pick the division / link repeated subtraction to division / find the pair that does not match.

lines.text: Let's take away four candies at a time.
Twelve divided by four is three.
Taking away four, three times, is the same as twelve divided by four.
Ten minus two, minus two, minus two, minus two, minus two, equals zero.
Twelve minus four, minus four, minus four, equals zero.
Fifteen minus five, minus five, minus five, equals zero.
Eight minus two, minus two, minus two, minus two, equals zero.
Match the taking away with the division.
